judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue: non-Error rejections (strings, plain objects, undefined) are wrapped in an Error with `cause` set to the original value, existing Error instances are passed through unchanged, the caller receives the original rejection verbatim, and both `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` are properly updated. In `chatOrchestrator.ts`, the candidate uses `String(error)` with a `try/catch` and fallback message (`'Non-Error rejection'`) rather than `JSON.stringify(value) ?? String(value)` as in the reference, which is a slightly less descriptive message for plain objects (`'[object Object]'` vs JSON) but completely valid per the ticket. The candidate also splits the new tests into two separate test files (`onErrorIdentity.test.ts` and `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts`) instead of adding a test case to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and includes minor harness artifacts (`.lore/dod.md` and `scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs`).
